claude_proposed_widenings.name: SpeciesTraitMechanics.build_time_choice_of_mechanics
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The trait is one species unit whose runtime behavior is selected once from multiple mutually exclusive ancestry benefits; the chosen branch, not all branches, should exist at runtime, and the choice must preserve the shared PB-scaled resource and long-rest reset.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Choose one of the following benefits... you can use the chosen benefit a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: SpeciesTraitMechanics.triggered_reaction_and_on_hit_trigger
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The available ancestry branches include reaction-shaped mechanics and on-hit riders, but species traits currently only admit passive or activation families.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage to it... / When you take damage, you can take a Reaction...
